scientific_integrity: A complete proof and reproducible exact-rational sign certificate are included. The coefficient identity is classical and not claimed as new; the proposed new statement is the sharp family-wide root-type transition.
scientific_limitations: Equal planar Cartesian factors only. The root-type classification does not settle unequal factors or earlier unindexed priority; no independent audit has been performed.
title: A sharp isoperimetric transition for Cartesian squares of planar convex bodies
